Dear Sir,
In continuation of the notice dated June 7,2021,we are pleased to advise that on
November 29,2021,the Company received Rs.59.401Billion from thePowerPurchaser
in theform of one-third cash,one-third GovernmentIjara Sukuk,and one-third Pakistan
InvestmentBonds.This constitutes thesecond installmentof 60%ofreceivables at the
cut-offdateofNovember30,2020.
You are requested to disseminate the information to the Members of the Exchange
accordingly.
